en: LORELEI: Keep your filthy hands\noff the POKéMON in the cave!\pDo as I say, or you'll have me to\nanswer to!
Aww, shut it, lady, and leave\nus be.\pDon't let your glasses get all\nsteamed up!

LORELEI: {PLAYER}?!
What are you doing here?\pNo, we can catch up later.
Right now, I need your help.\pHelp me kick these poachers out
before they do anything else.\pThey've been catching POKéMON
here, then selling them off!\pAre you ready?
You take that one, please!
W-what?!\pWho says we can't do what we want\nwith the POKéMON we catch?

LORELEI: Humph.
So despicably weak.\pYou!
Tell me!\pWhere have you taken the captured
POKéMON?\pI'm smashing your ring once and
for all!
N-no way!\nI'm not telling you that!

LORELEI: If you won't confess,
we'll deep-freeze you.\pMy LAPRAS is furious for what
you've done to its friends.\pGo, LAPRAS!
ICE BEAM…

Wawaah! Okay!
I'll talk!\pThe POKéMON are in the ROCKET
WAREHOUSE on FIVE ISLAND.\pThere! I said it!
We'll be going now!\p…But I doubt you'll ever make it
into the ROCKET WAREHOUSE!\pHeheheheh!

{PLAYER}, thank you.
But this is awful…\pI was born and raised here on
these islands.\pI had no idea that those horrible
criminals were loose here…
